details:
I propose a 5th status type. It's color would be yellow, and it would function like a mix of the Online green and Ask me orange status's.

Upon changing to this status, the user would be prompted to choose which favorite friends lists or specific friends they'd like to be whitelisted. The selected friends would be able to join the user freely as long as they are in a friends/friends+ world similar to Online green, but those who aren't chosen would see the account as if it's on Ask me orange.

Maybe it's redundant, but me and a friend agreed it'd be useful and convenient.

What if you need to go AFK while a friend is getting on to join? You'd likely think to leave your account on blue and go. But what if someone unfavorable or someone you simply don't wish to speak to at the time is online, and you know without a doubt that they'd join if they saw you on blue?

It just seems easy.
title: New status type to allow free joining for favorited/specific friends while others must request
